lead.description: the probability of a condition in the population before a test result is taken into account

overview_sentence: The base rate is the probability of a condition before a test result is seen.

self_checks.title: Mammogram predictive value
self_checks.prompt: Base rate 0.0035, sensitivity 0.89, false-positive rate 0.07. What is the positive predictive value, to three decimals?
self_checks.answer: The positive predictive value is about 0.043.

self_checks.title: A less rare condition
self_checks.prompt: Base rate 0.20, sensitivity 0.89, false-positive rate 0.07. What is the positive predictive value, to three decimals?
self_checks.answer: The positive predictive value is about 0.761.

self_checks.title: One percent prevalence
self_checks.prompt: Base rate 0.01, sensitivity 0.90, false-positive rate 0.05. What is the positive predictive value?
self_checks.answer: The positive predictive value is 0.009/0.0585, about 0.154.
